node.statement: To complete the saturated diagonal c2(1,1,2) source-line branch, compile and classify every literal internal source-star assignment across target, sign, ramification, boundary, q-slice, and full quotient gates, or prove a restricted symmetry for that complete system. The aligned-positive unramified registry has 36 semantic cells and is completely PROVED by a disjoint seven-packet census. In the affine near-positive branch, two exact restricted q-slice transports reduce 108 semantic literal cells to 42 orbits: 12 contain the canonical F00/M00 systems and 30 direct representatives enter the exact residual registry. Dual exact certificates close all F02, F04, and F06 representatives. The M01/M02 block and the final M03 block are excluded by complete-chart classifications followed by direct first-quotient replay on their finite survivors. The affine near-positive direct residual is therefore empty. A separate direct compiler proves all 48 literal positive projective-boundary cells q-slice empty without endpoint normalization. Direct reconstruction on two complementary charts also proves all twelve aligned-negative assignments empty across 32 genuine consistency components. The natural reciprocal-pair-swap centralizer extension is exactly refuted. Only the 48 near-negative assignment/root cells remain.
